sources.scope: Hennepin County assessment parcels on the Minneapolis side of the combined Minneapolis–Saint Paul settlement. Thirteen aligned cells plus four adjacent pans and an expanded 35-view check around the unchanged WUP locator yielded 10 distinct full county parcel geometries. Native EPSG:26915 count and object-ID manifests agreed, forced three-row paging completed, all 10 fresh COUNTY_PIN reads reproduced geometry, and explicit absence, full footprint lookup and complete proposal binding passed. GEOS in EPSG:26915 found no invalid polygons, duplicate geometry, sampled overlaps above 0.01 m² or operation errors. Only OBJECTID transport keys and native COUNTY_PIN identifiers accompany geometry. The exact WUP point returned no parcel; nearby verified polygons remain usable. Hennepin metadata describes taxed, tax-exempt and stacked multi-PID assessment parcels; the small sampled area contains no stacked duplicates, while broader county completeness and topology remain unverified. The endpoint is named Parcels_2025; its current revision and identity continuity after replacement were not established. Saint Paul/Ramsey coverage remains a separate source. Published survey and legal-use notices are retained as scope information.
